speech.wav is synthesized, not recorded from a person. It was generated with eSpeak NG 1.52.0:

espeak-ng -v en-us -s 150 -w speech.wav "What is the capital of France?"

The output is 16-bit signed PCM, mono, 22050 Hz, 47523 samples (2.16 s), and regenerates byte for
byte with that version (sha256 c02e3025012e3f3b2d564940365bc79146964f33837dd6921fe1e969455534f2).
The live test resamples it to the 24 kHz PCM16 the Realtime API takes.
